integrity: The upper bound follows from an exact similarity representation of the residual iteration and the spectral-equivalence enclosure. A two-dimensional closed-form SPD pair attains the bound exactly. The natural A^{-1}-residual contraction is proved separately, so the Euclidean amplification is not confused with divergence.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic theorem for a fixed SPD preconditioner and one unit-step preconditioned Richardson correction. It does not treat varying, nonsymmetric, or indefinite preconditioners, Krylov acceleration, finite-precision residual gaps, or backward stability.
title: Sharp Euclidean residual-safety frontier for spectrally equivalent preconditioned Richardson
